I stayed at Yube1 Sigma League, Siruseri, Chennai from June 23, 2025 to October 22, 2025.
The villa offers 3-sharing rooms, and I paid ₹8,000 per person, plus around ₹2,000 per person for electricity — which is quite high compared to other PGs or villas nearby. When I moved in, I was not clearly informed about the electricity charges, and later it turned out to be very expensive, which felt a bit unfair.

Another issue is the 15-day notice period before checkout and the advance deposit. I paid ₹8,000 as advance, but only received ₹6,200 back. They said the deduction was for electricity, which I feel is not transparent.

There is no food service, and Wi-Fi rarely worked even after raising the issue multiple times.

[{"Name":"Jothi arasu","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXh8-mT2ccLZBQiDEH4XG8aNHzMhYqzYm4dU2BpC6tsAZOSX8Uq=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"1 Star – Extremely disappointing experience

My sister stayed at Easvari Grand PG for Women from June 15th in a 4-sharing room. At the time of joining, we were told the rent was around ₹6,800 per month and paid ₹5,000 as advance. We also paid ₹3,850 for the initial 17 days, which worked out to ₹226 per day.

Unfortunately, the experience was extremely poor. From the day she joined until now, the room was not properly cleaned. Food was not provided properly, the heater was not working, and the toilet flush also had issues. Despite repeatedly informing the management, there was no proper action.

There was also an electricity disconnection for a full day because the EB bill had apparently not been paid for several months. During that time, there was no electricity and no proper food arrangement. I personally called the owner and supervisor more than 10 times, but there was no proper response.
